en.name: Worcestershire sauce
en.summary: Worcestershire sauce is a long-fermented, vinegar-based sauce with anchovy, tamarind, molasses and spice. The published figure is about 1 year from purchase in the cupboard, and a shelf-stable commercial bottle is safe at room temperature after opening — refrigeration is about quality, not safety.
en.pantry: The cupboard is where it belongs: cool, dark, capped tightly, away from the hob, about 1 year from purchase. Shelf-stable commercial Worcestershire sauce is safe when stored at room temperature after opening; quality, not safety, is the reason the labels on these products suggest refrigerating them, and refrigeration simply ensures commercial sauces and condiments stay fresh for a longer period of time. Vinegar, salt and long fermentation are what make that possible. Keep the bottle out of sunlight, which dulls the colour and the aroma faster than anything else.
en.fridge: Refrigeration is optional and there is no separate published timeline for it. If you use the bottle rarely and want it to taste its best for longer, the fridge is a reasonable place for it after opening; if you use it weekly, the cupboard is perfectly fine. Either way, wipe the neck and the inside of the cap after pouring, because the sugar and molasses in it make drips sticky and a gummed thread stops the cap seating properly. Shake before each use; sediment settling is normal.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for Worcestershire sauce and no reason to freeze it. Vinegar and salt already preserve it, and a bottle usually lasts longer than the household's enthusiasm for it. Freezing would separate the sediment and change nothing useful. If you use it only for the occasional marinade or Bloody Mary, buy the smallest bottle you can find.
spoilage: Mould around the neck, the cap or in sticky residue on the thread
A musty or fermented-off smell rather than a sharp, savoury, malty one
Flat, purely salty taste with none of the original complexity — old rather than unsafe
Solid matter beyond the usual fine sediment that settles
tips: Shake before pouring; sediment settles and that is normal.
Wipe the neck and cap after every use so the cap does not gum shut.
Keep it out of sunlight — light dulls the colour and aroma fastest.
Buy a small bottle unless you cook with it regularly.

faq.q: Does Worcestershire sauce need to be refrigerated after opening?
faq.a: No. A shelf-stable commercial bottle is safe at room temperature after opening. Refrigeration keeps it fresher for longer, which is why the label suggests it.

faq.q: How long does Worcestershire sauce last?
faq.a: About 1 year from purchase in a cool dark cupboard.
There is no timeline and no reason to. Vinegar and salt already keep it perfectly well.

faq.q: Why has my Worcestershire sauce gone flat-tasting?
faq.a: Light, air and time dull the aroma. It is a quality change; mould around the cap is the real warning sign.

zh.name: 伍斯特醬
zh.summary: 伍斯特醬是經過長時間發酵、以醋為基底的醬料，含鯷魚、羅望子、糖蜜和香料。公布的數字是從購買日起算約 1 年（櫥櫃保存），而常溫販售的市售瓶裝開封後放室溫仍然安全——冷藏講的是品質，不是安全。
zh.pantry: 櫥櫃就是它該待的地方：陰涼、避光、蓋緊、遠離爐火，從購買日起算大約 1 年。常溫販售的市售伍斯特醬，開封後放室溫仍然是安全的；標籤建議冷藏的理由是品質而不是安全，冷藏只是讓市售醬料維持新鮮更久。讓它做得到的是醋、鹽和長時間發酵。請避免日曬，陽光讓色澤和香氣變鈍的速度比任何因素都快。
zh.fridge: 冷藏是選擇題，而且沒有另外公布的冷藏期限。如果你很少用這瓶，又希望它更久保持好味道，開封後放冰箱是合理的；如果你每週都會用，放櫥櫃完全沒問題。不管哪一種，倒完都要擦瓶口和瓶蓋內側，因為裡面的糖和糖蜜會讓滴漏變黏，螺紋一黏，瓶蓋就蓋不確實。每次使用前搖一搖；沉澱析出是正常的。
zh.freezer: 伍斯特醬沒有冷凍期限，也沒有冷凍的理由。醋和鹽已經在保存它，而且一瓶通常撐得比家裡對它的熱情還久。冷凍只會把沉澱攪散，沒有任何實質好處。如果你只偶爾做醃料或血腥瑪麗，請買你找得到最小的瓶子。
spoilage: 瓶口、瓶蓋或螺紋黏漬處長霉
聞起來有霉味或發酵異味，而不是嗆香帶麥芽的鹹鮮
味道扁平只剩鹹、完全沒有原本的層次——那是老了，不是不安全
除了正常會沉澱的細顆粒之外，還有其他固體物
tips: 倒之前搖一搖；沉澱是正常現象。
每次用完擦瓶口和瓶蓋，免得瓶蓋黏死。
避免日曬——光讓色澤和香氣變鈍最快。
除非經常下廚用到，否則請買小瓶。

faq.q: 伍斯特醬開封後要冰嗎？
faq.a: 不用。常溫販售的市售瓶裝開封後放室溫仍然安全。冷藏是為了維持新鮮更久，所以標籤才會建議。
陰涼避光的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 1 年。
沒有對應期限，也沒有理由。醋和鹽已經把它保存得很好。

faq.q: 伍斯特醬味道變淡了怎麼回事？
faq.a: 光、空氣和時間會讓香氣變鈍。那是品質變化；瓶蓋周圍長霉才是真正的警訊。
